blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defending champion Criss Cross showed National University-Archipelago Builders who runs the league with a statement 23-25, 25-16, 25-20, 25-20 win in their highly anticipated showdown in the Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday at the Filoil EcoOil Centre. Five-time Conference MVP Jude Garcia imposed his dominance with 24 points off 19 kills, three blocks, and an ace. He also had 16 excellent receptions to keep Criss Cross unbeaten in four games tied with ClearSkiiin. Setter Adrian Villados also shone brightly for the two-time Spikers’ Turf champion with a conference-high 38 excellent sets to go with nine digs and […]...
